scripts.build: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force www -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path www -Force; Copy-Item index.html,app.js,style.css,firebase-config.js,manifest.json,sw.js www/; Copy-Item -Recurse icons www/"
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
